summary: All five targets (35, 38, 39, 43, 50) promoted to exact full records; nothing stayed zone-level. The fandom wiki (mairimashita-irumakun.fandom.com) carries per-episode manga fields with page splits, corroborated by animefillerguide's chapter table on every chapter set, with TV Tropes independently confirming the S2 finale 92-93 <-> 94 swap. Two surprises: (1) the stored ep 44 anchor end=94 is wrong — ep 44 adapts 92, 93 (p.1-19), 95 (p.1-4, 8-13) and never touches 94 (ep 43 does); repair included. (2) the ep 50 ch-90 graft is a mid-episode flashback inserted during the Iruma/Lied eating scene, not a cold open before 106-108 as the stored annotation says; annotation refined. AFG's 'Volume 6 (chapters 143-151)' continua label is a mislabeled v17, which likely resolves flag #756 in Wikipedia's favor.

Opens by finishing the 76/77 tails from ep 38, then runs 79-81 and the first 2 pages of 82; start=79 per majority rule (first full chapter; tails are not the bulk). AFG confirms set {76,77,79,80,81,82}; fandom ch 79-82 pages all credit ep 39. Stored ep40 anchor (82 p.3-20 + 83-85) dovetails exactly.

Verified: ep 43 = ch 94 only (Ameri/Iruma Aqua Case date), pulled ahead of 92-93 so Magical Street could close the season. Fandom ep page + ch 94 reverse map + AFG + TV Tropes reorder statement all agree.

Repair companion (see repairs): stored end=94 was wrong — ep 44 adapts 92 + 93 (p.1-19) + parts of 95; ch 94 belongs to ep 43. Rest of 95 (p.5-22) opens ep 45 per its page. Fandom ch 92/93 pages credit ep 44.

Set {90, 106 p.18-19, 107, 108} confirmed by fandom ep page + AFG + fandom ch 106 reverse map (eps 49+50). Ch 90 ('Sabbath', skipped in S2) is grafted as a mid-episode flashback during the Iruma/Lied eating scene, so it sits inside the 107/108 material — exact insertion page unstated, ordering of '90' in the list is approximate. Start=107 per majority rule (opens finishing the 106 tail).

Ep 44 adapts 92, 93 (p.1-19), 95 (p.1-4, 8-13): fandom ep page manga field, fandom ch 92/93 reverse maps (ep 44), AFG row 44 = '92, 93, 95', TV Tropes confirms the 92-93/94 order swap. flags_for_sean: ch 95 split discrepancy: ep 44 page claims 95 (p.1-4, 8-13) while ep 45 page claims 95 (p.5-22) — overlap on p.8-13, and the fandom Chapter 95 page credits only ep 45. Recorded ep 44 per its episode page; the overlap is likely re-shown finale material. Ep 45 (not a target) = 95 (p.5-22), 96, 97 (p.4-8) if you want it later.
